inputs.raw: Lossless query-call JSONL supplied by the experiment runner.
inputs.index: The frozen source index JSONL used by the model run.
inputs.gold: Frozen benchmark gold JSON; never supplied to the model as query or index content.
inputs.locator_resolution: A source-verified map from each unique gold evidence location to source headings/pages/slides/sheet numbers/cells/intervals and matching frozen index chunk IDs. Verify the gold, index, and source-file hashes before aggregation.

dev.repetitions: Use repetitions present in raw records; do not infer model output when absent.

populations.denominator: Quality metrics use answerable queries in each split. Missing or failed calls remain in the denominator and score zero retrieval hits.

ranking.asset_unit: One row per asset_id, retaining the maximum finite score; ties preserve input rank. If scores are unavailable, retain the earliest explicit rank or raw list position and list the missing/nonfinite score separately.
ranking.chunk_unit: One row per normalized source path plus locator, retaining the maximum finite score; different locators within one asset remain separate.
ranking.ordering: Use explicit rank when complete; otherwise descending finite score when complete; otherwise preserve the raw ranking list order.

metrics.asset_hit_at_k: Fraction of answerable queries with a gold evidence asset among the top k distinct assets.
metrics.asset_mrr_at_10: Macro-average reciprocal rank of the first gold asset among the top 10 distinct assets; zero when absent.
metrics.fine_evidence_hit_at_k: Fraction with at least one gold evidence entry fully covered by the top-k deduplicated locators for its gold asset/path. Text/media semantic support is not required by this retrieval-only measure.
metrics.fine_evidence_mrr_at_10: Macro-average reciprocal rank of the first prefix of the top 10 distinct locators that fully covers any gold evidence entry; zero when absent.
metrics.fine_evidence_coverage_at_k: Per-query fraction of gold evidence entries fully represented by the top-k retrieved locators, macro-averaged over answerable queries.
metrics.fine_evidence_unit_fraction_coverage_at_: Macro-average, first within each query across its evidence entries, of the fraction of annotated interval duration or spreadsheet cells covered by top k. Report this separately from binary full-entry coverage.
metrics.complete_evidence_at_k: Fraction of answerable queries for which all evidence entries are fully represented by top k. Count each evidence entry separately; NKB-070 requires all four V-SAFE intervals.

coverage_rules.time_interval: Combine the retrieved source intervals for the same gold asset/path after rounding endpoints to the locator precision of 0.001 seconds. An evidence entry is covered only when their union covers the entire annotated interval without a visible gap; partial duration is reported separately and gaps are never bridged by the minimum/maximum envelope.
coverage_rules.spreadsheet_cells: Expand each evidence cell range. An evidence entry is covered only when all annotated cells in that range are present across the retrieved source locators; the covered-cell fraction is reported separately.
coverage_rules.page_slide_section: The retrieved source locator must identify the annotated page, slide, or section. DOCX is resolved by exact source heading; page numbers without explicit page breaks are marked unverified and are not used as a fuzzy match.
coverage_rules.asset_only: Asset title/id match is never counted as fine evidence.

metrics.secondary_precision_at_k: Report asset P@k and structurally matched locator P@k separately. Denominator is min(k, unique returned items); if no item is returned, record N/A and the empty-result count.

fact_support_diagnostic.method: For locator-matched results with index text, record whether any normalized required_fact occurs as a literal substring. Missing index text is unknown.
fact_support_diagnostic.interpretation: This is a conservative lexical diagnostic, not the primary retrieval evidence score, not a semantic entailment judgment, and not generated-answer correctness. Native media without index text is not a primary-score failure.

unknowns.unknown_scores: Missing, invalid, or nonfinite score values in raw ranked candidates; emitted to a separate table.
unknowns.unresolved_locators: Gold annotations that cannot be resolved to source/index locations, and raw candidates that cannot be resolved to the frozen index, are reported separately and excluded from fine-evidence scoring rather than treated as model false hits/misses.
unknowns.unanswerable: Report actual candidate ranks and scores separately for the 3 test and 1 dev unanswerable queries; do not treat retrieval as correct abstention or choose a threshold from test.

latency.first_query: First chronological test call, reported separately.

guardrails: Do not edit questions, gold, index, model settings, or run protocol after viewing test scores.
Do not call retrieval results generated-answer accuracy, arithmetic correctness, or abstention accuracy.
Do not pool the earlier separate 24-question run with this benchmark.
